blocks.text: Features of 3, 3.5 & 4 BHK Apartments at Heart of Harmony
Exclusive Low-Density Living

With 137 residences across 24 floors and only 6 homes per floor, Heart of Harmony is among the most low-density premium high-rises launching on Hosur Road. Zero common walls between apartments means you never share a wall with a neighbour — a standard rarely seen in Bengaluru's mid- and luxury segment. The building's vehicle-free podium and 84% open green space reinforce this commitment to calm, unhurried living.
270° Panoramic Views

Every home at Heart of Harmony is designed with three open sides, delivering sweeping 270° views of South Bengaluru's skyline and the green landscape surrounding Hosur Road. Upper-floor residences, in particular, offer a visual experience rarely available at this price point in the city.
Private Sky Garden Terraces

Open-to-sky garden decks appear every three floors throughout the tower — bringing natural light, fresh air, and a tangible sense of greenery to the building's mid and upper floors. These elevated private terraces are one of Heart of Harmony's most distinctive design features, setting it apart from standard high-rise developments in the area.
Grand Arrival & Hotel-Style Lobby

A double-height grand lobby, hotel-style drop-off zone, and seamless basement parking access create an arrival experience that matches the project's premium positioning. Every detail from the entrance gate to the elevator lobby reflects CKPC's background building environments for Fortune 100 companies.
Spacious Layouts & Premium Finishes

Open-flow planning between the living room and kitchen creates a sense of uninterrupted space. Carefully selected finishes across flooring, fixtures, and kitchen fittings reflect a quiet luxury that supports everyday family living rather than just visual impressiveness at the time of sale.
